paragraphs: I have been in the Software Testing role for the last 17+ years; however, I must tell you that most of my time was spent in manual testing. When I got into this role, specifically, it was the time when there used to be a lot of desktop applications. I started my career in 2008 as a Commerce graduate and had no background in engineering. At first, it was challenging to understand what programming, testing, and releases entailed. Thanks to all my mentors and guides, who helped me a lot to understand the basic concepts of software testing and how the actual process works.

I have been asked by many about my career transformation journey from Manual Testing to Test Automation Engineer, hence I thought of creating this repository, which has the learning path I followed to become a Test Automation Engineer.
